reason: SAM passed five-frame qualitative temporal validation but its unchanged full-resolution MPS all-25 run exceeded 90 minutes without finalizing outputs. No manual ground truth exists, so the results do not justify accuracy metrics or automatic biological claims.

methods.otsu: Useful, fast dark seed-body baseline. It merges touching seeds and connected components are not seed counts.
methods.germination_candidate_mask: Exploratory yellow-candidate signal only; it is not a radicle mask.
methods.yolov8x_germ: All-25 inference completed (2,306 detections). Numeric labels 1-4 remain biologically unlabeled; detections are not seed counts and temporal counts are unstable.
methods.seedgerm_vig_unet: Faithful one-image low-level SavedModel inference works. Official source establishes channel 1 as the retained binary mask. The output requires manual validation before use on this domain.
methods.sam_2_1: Five-frame fixed-parameter automatic validation is visually meaningful (110-136 raw masks, 52.1-62.1% union coverage, 5.2-11.8% high-overlap-mask fraction). It frequently separates contacts, but can join seed body and emergent tissue. The all-25 MPS run did not finalize after >90 minutes, so it is not scalable here.

recommendations.seed_body_foreground_segmentation: Otsu remains the current scalable baseline; U-Net and SAM need manual annotation-based validation before replacement.
recommendations.individual_seed_instance_separation: SAM 2.1 is the most promising tested qualitative proposal source, but SAM masks are not seed counts and need validation.
recommendations.touching_seed_separation: SAM 2.1 qualitatively separates many contacts better than Otsu across the five sampled times; this is not an accuracy claim.
recommendations.seed_localization: YOLO boxes and SAM proposals can assist review; neither is a validated seed count and YOLO's numeric class labels remain biologically unlabeled.
recommendations.germination_stage_information: YOLO numeric classes cannot be used for named stages because the official mapping was not established in the inspected source.
recommendations.yellow_green_germination_tissue: The Phase 2.5 combined yellow candidate is exploratory only and must not be called a radicle mask.
recommendations.pale_white_radicle_representation: SAM often includes pale emerging structures but can merge them into the seed mask; it is not a validated radicle representation.
recommendations.later_tracking_suitability: Not ready: no cross-frame identity validation or manual ground truth exists.
recommendations.computational_scalability: Otsu is scalable. Current full-resolution automatic SAM on MPS is not: the all-25 run exceeded 90 minutes without final output.
recommendations.hybrid_pipeline: Prefer Otsu for the baseline, with SAM only as a manually reviewed instance-separation aid and YOLO boxes as auxiliary localization.

scientific_cautions: No IoU, Dice, mAP, or accuracy claims without manual ground truth.

later_considerations.sam_better_than_otsu_for_instance_segmen: Qualitatively yes on the five sampled frames; not quantitatively validated.
later_considerations.yolo_seg_fine_tuning_later: Consider only after manual annotation and a defined evaluation split.
later_considerations.unet_fine_tuning_later: Consider only after manual annotation and a defined evaluation split.
